description:
Candidate Brassica genes for a trait, with crop evidence ranked above inference: (1) named genes whose source
sentence in a paper links them to the trait (curated or literature gene symbols, e.g. a dwarf mutant gene for
plant height), (2) genes named with the trait in the same sentence or paragraph of open-access papers,
(3) genes reported by the authors at published GWAS associations (GWAS Atlas), (4) orthologues of Arabidopsis genes
with mutant or GO evidence for the trait, or with significant natural-variation GWAS SNPs (AraGWAS). Each gene gives its evidence, symbols and score parts; B. napus genes in askBrassica also give pangenome presence (of 53 accessions). Start
here for 'which genes are candidates for <trait>'. trait: words ('plant height', 'flowering time', 'pod shatter').
Literature and GWAS genes are text or statistical evidence, not proof of function; Arabidopsis-only candidates are
inferred: say which kind each candidate has.
name: trait_candidate_genes
